summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for the NEW password-auth + email-OTP-on-signup flow (AI + Music Hub). Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass covering signup validation (password<8 -> 422, invalid email -> 422, blank name -> 422), pending-signup + verify-signup (creates user & returns JWT+user, wrong code -> 400 with attempts increment, 5-attempt lockout, no-pending -> 400), duplicate signup -> 409, login success/wrong-password/unknown-email (401 generic 'Invalid email or password'), forgot-password always 200 (with reset doc created only for known email), reset-password (password<8 -> 422, wrong code -> 400, correct -> old-password 401 + new-password 200), /api/auth/me + PUT /api/auth/profile with new JWT, chat/message via Claude 4.6 (+history persist + clear + empty rejection), notes/from-song via Claude, notes/detect on synthetic 440 Hz WAV (A4 correctly detected after installing ffmpeg), and channel posts + like toggle + comments. Frontend: mobile 390x844 viewport. Verified: login screen loads; toggle to signup screen; signup validations (password mismatch toast, short-password toast); real signup (delivered+tag@resend.dev) navigates to verify screen; seeded code -> verify-submit -> navigates to /home; wrong-password login shows generic 'Invalid email or password' toast; correct login -> /home; forgot -> reset screen; reset with seeded code -> back to login; login with new password -> /home; Home tiles all 4 render (Chat/Studio/Musical Notes/Public Channel). No React Native red screen. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected. Note: signup with @example.com returns 502 from email provider (expected — undeliverable domain), pending_signups doc IS still written so the flow can be exercised by seeding.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py auth logic is correct: signup writes pending_signups (bcrypt code_hash, expires_at, attempts) upsert, then send_email; verify-signup validates expiry & attempts before code check; reset flow mirrors this. No _id ever leaks in responses.
login intentionally uses a generic 401 'Invalid email or password' for both wrong-password and unknown-email — correct enumeration-safe UX.

forgot-password ALWAYS returns 200 for both known/unknown emails, and password_resets doc is only created for known emails — correct enumeration-safe behavior. NOTE: for a known email whose send_email fails (502), the reset doc IS still created (because it is written before send_email) — code path is fine for testing/seed override, but consider a try/except around send_email to avoid leaking 502 to the client when the email doc creation succeeded but delivery failed.
validate_password enforces >=8 chars and <=72 bytes (bcrypt limit) — good.
verify-signup + reset-password both delete their pending/reset docs on success or hard failure (expiry / lockout) — good hygiene.

login.tsx correctly wires all requested testIDs (login-, signup-, verify-, forgot-, reset-, back-to-login, resend-code, go-to-signup, go-to-login, forgot-password); eye toggle uses secureTextEntry={!showPw} + setShowPw toggle on rightIcon Pressable — wired correctly.
